title: Google Container Registry shut down
summary: Google Cloud states that Container Registry was shut down effective March 18, 2025 and writing images to Container Registry became unavailable.
migration_path: Migrate Container Registry workloads and images to Artifact Registry; compatible gcr.io repositories can be hosted by Artifact Registry.
user_impact: Container Registry can no longer accept image writes; affected workloads must use Artifact Registry or its gcr.io compatibility path.
